SELECT O.id, O.create_time, O.creator, O.is_deleted, O.update_time, O.updater, O.order_date, O.order_state, O.order_total, O.service_mode, O.business_id, O.customer_id, O.address_id,
b.business_name as business_business_name, b.business_address as business_business_address, b.business_explain as business_business_explain, b.business_img as business_business_img, b.order_type_id as business_order_type_id, b.start_price as business_start_price, b.delivery_price as business_delivery_price, b.remarks as business_remarks, b.creator as business_creator, b.updater as business_updater, b.create_time as business_create_time, b.update_time as business_update_time, b.is_deleted as business_deleted,
u.id as customer_id, u.username as customer_username, u.create_time as customer_create_time, u.creator as customer_creator, u.is_deleted as customer_deleted, u.update_time as customer_update_time, u.updater as customer_updater,
ub.id as business_user_id, ub.username as business_user_username, ub.create_time as business_user_create_time, ub.creator as business_user_creator, ub.is_deleted as business_user_deleted, ub.update_time as business_user_update_time, ub.updater as business_user_updater,

FROM orders O LEFT JOIN business b ON O.business_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ub ON b.user_id = ub.id AND ub.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = O.customer_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN delivery_address ad ON ad.id = O.address_id AND ad.is_deleted = 0 WHERE O.customer_id =#{userId} AND O.is_deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (create_time, creator, is_deleted, update_time, updater, order_date, order_state, order_total, business_id, customer_id, address_id, delivery_price, address_snapshot, contact_name_snapshot, contact_sex_snapshot, contact_tel_snapshot, idempotency_key, service_mode) VALUES (#{createTime}, #{creator}, #{isDeleted}, #{updateTime}, #{updater}, #{orderDate}, #{orderState}, #{orderTotal}, #{businessId}, #{customerId}, #{addressId}, #{deliveryPrice}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{contactNameSnapshot}, #{contactSexSnapshot}, #{contactTelSnapshot}, #{idempotencyKey}, COALESCE(#{serviceMode}, 'DELIVERY'))
